svg.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif
svg.title: DeepEnsemble — member architectures
svg.text: Each block: Conv(k×k, pad k/2, no bias) + BatchNorm + ReLU; ×½ = MaxPool 2×2 (all blocks but the last). Rectangle height ∝ channel width; colour = kernel size.
dec Lk: frozen-trunk BlockDecoder (ConvTranspose 4×4 stride-2 stages + BN + ReLU) reconstructing the 128² input from block k — the reconstructions drive the ensemble bias/variance decomposition.
